With above and more such benefits, one is surely bound to have a seamless professional journey. So, what’s keeping you in dilemma? Be quick and choose 91springboard coworking space today!

All in all, Awfis stands for inspiration, excellence, maximum growth, minimum waste, priority to the community, integrity and most importantly getting more with less.

Top Awfis Coworking Spaces:-

Awfis offers a wide range of fully-furnished coworking spaces across various cities in India. Moreover, all of them are equipped with modern amenities for the comfort of their coworkers and other working professionals. Below is a list of the top Awfis coworking spaces

  1. 1. Awfis Nelson Mandela Marg

Awfis Nelson Mandela Marg is a reputable coworking space located in the heart of South Delhi, Vasant Kunj. This workplace is ideal for people from diverse backgrounds and offers affordable workplace solutions. A variety of workstations are offered by Awfis like dedicated desks, private cabins, hot desks, managed offices, day passes, conference rooms, and more.   1. 2. Awfis Camp Nucleus mall

Awfis Camp Nucleus mall is an exquisite coworking space located in Nucleus Mall, Pune. This coworking space is meticulously designed that offers fully functional & highly tech-enabled workstations such as hot desks, day pass, dedicated desks, private cabins, managed office space, etc. This entire Awfis coworking space is well-equipped with modern amenities & facilities such as high-speed elevators, power backup, free tea/coffee, reception, a pantry, ample parking space, cleaning services, well-lit and ventilated workstations, etc.

This Awfis shared office space is close to various bus terminals i.e GPO bus stop, Bright Petrol Pump Bus Stop & Westend Bus Stop located at a distance of less than 1km. Moreover, this coworking space is close to various nearby landmarks within a radius of 3-5km such as Kumar Pacific mall, Gera mall, SGS mall, Oysters International School, Jehangir Hospital, Pune Medical Foundation, Effingut Brewerkz, 11 East Street Cafe and more.

This Awfis coworking space is located in Ambience mall which is the largest mall in India. It offers a variety of seating options such as dedicated desks, private cabins, managed office space, virtual office space, hot desks, day passes, etc. It provides access to modern amenities such as high-speed Wi-Fi, printers, scanners, tea/coffee dispenser, NFC-based cards, ample parking space, and more. 

All the members of the Awfis Ambience mall coworking space get access to Awfis Reward programs. It is close to Micromax Moulsari Avenue Metro Station & Indusland Bank Cyber City Metro Station, i.e. 1-2 km away from this location. The IGI Airport is 2-5km away from Awfis Ambience mall. Moreover, this location is surrounded by renowned eateries such as Spectra, Chili’s Ambience mall Gurgaon, Zanotta, Mamagoto, Auntie Fung’s Asian & Chinese, Diya, and more to chill out with your friends and colleagues. 

  1. 4. Awfis St. Marks Road

This Awfis coworking space is strategically located in the center of Bangalore and it boasts 800+ workspaces such as Flexi Desks, private cabins, hot desks, dedicated desks, day passes, conference rooms, and more. The entire workspace offers modern and high-tech enabled facilities such as high-speed elevators, WiFi, Power backup, 24/7 security, NFC-based access cards, CCTV monitoring, ergonomic furniture, well-lit & ventilated workstations, air-conditioning & centrally heated, etc.

It is well-connected with areas like Richmond town, M.G Road, Residency Road, Infantry road, Shivajinagar, and UB City. Some of the nearby cafes to hang out with your friends are Cafe Mor’ish, Kafegram food & Beverages, Cafe Treat, Istoria cafe, Mecca cafe many more. 

  1. 5. Awfis Connaught place 

This Awfis Space Solution coworking space is located in Connaught place, i.e. a hub of Millenials. This workplace belongs to all working professionals, freelancers, startups, and more at affordable rates to help them grow their businesses in a cost-effective manner. The Awfis shared office space has a vibrant atmosphere that creates efficiency and builds productivity. The entire workspace is filled with modern amenities such as high-speed internet, ensured security, CCTV monitoring, high-speed elevators, spacious & bright workstations, printer/scanner, projector, power backup, and ample parking space.

It offers an exciting range of seating options such as dedicated desks, hot desks, private cabins, managed office space, day passes, conference rooms, meeting rooms, and more. Moreover, this workspace is easily accessible via public transport as it is well-connected with the Rajiv Chowk metro station, i.e. 180 m away from the office. Shivaji Bridge railway station is located within a walking distance of this location. Commuting via cabs, autos, etc. is easy for coworkers to reach the office on time. It is close to the famous Palika Bazaar, Shankar market, Carnival Cinemas, Farzi cafe, Zaffran restaurant, Open House cafe, warehouse cafe, The Chai Story, Chaayos, Cafe Delhi Heights, Third Wave Coffee, and more.

Sophisticated locations with contemporary amenities: Awfis Coworking offers spaces in 10+ locations across India. These are Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Gurugram, Noida, Kolkata, Pune, Chandigarh, Ahmedabad, Chennai currently and upcoming in Udaipur, Dehradun, Indore, Aurangabad, Ghaziabad, Noida, and Jaipur. They offer amenities such as colorful workstations, high-speed internet, a pantry area, refreshments, ample parking space, and more. 

Maximum Productivity and Minimum Wastage: Awfis ensures the maximum amount of work productivity in its congenial environment at all times. With its modern amenities, members are bound to concentrate on their tasks, take a break and see their business growing at unmatched levels. This leads to minimum wastage of time, effort, and resources.
 
Socializing Events: Awfis Coworking ensures a fun-filled journey by organizing social events, workshops, networking sessions, parties, and much more. One is always encircled with a lot of zeal and enthusiasm for a better work lifestyle. 

Membership Benefits: Awfis has partnered with renowned brands that offer discounted and priority-based access to its coworking community.

Technology: Awfis offers the latest technology which helps in driving the maximum productivity out of its member community. 

So what’s keeping you in dilemma? Choose Awfis Space Solution Coworking Space today and thank them later!

It caters to all types and sizes of companies, making it accessible according to one’s budget and needs. 

Business Opportunities: Regus conducts regular social events, sessions, and workshops to create networking opportunities. Accessibility: Regus offices are located in prime locations with easy access to public transportation. Modern Work Environment: Regus offices are aesthetically designed to improve one’s productivity and can help significantly improve an employee’s morale. These spaces come along with all the necessary amenities, allowing businesses to focus on their growth and future endeavors.  

So, what are you waiting for? Grab affordable workspaces and be a part of the Regus community.

seo.footer_description:
Cowrks India was launched in Bellandur, Bangalore, in 2016. Sidharth Menda founded it with a vision of having instant office solutions to cater to diverse professional needs. Whether you’re a freelancer, a student, a small startup, an SME, or a large corporation, it provides flexible and unparalleled creative spaces while keeping innovation in mind. 

Now it has office centers in 6 metropolitan cities, from Bangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, and Delhi to Hyderabad and Noida. One can book from a wide spectrum of workspaces, such as managed offices, flexible offices, a day pass, virtual offices, event spaces, board rooms, and meeting rooms. 

These workspaces come equipped with planning and production support, world-class space designs, ample parking space, well-lit interiors, high-speed secure internet, premium hospitality, gourmet F&B offerings, and state-of-the-art AV. 

Additionally, it has a clientele range of over 30,000+ businesses, including prestigious companies like Decathlon, Swiggy, Razorpay, Freshworks, Nokia, and Truecaller. 

Why Choose Cowrks Coworking Spaces?

Diverse Community: Cowrks offers its clients a rich and diverse member base with professions of varied industries - 40% technology, 10% consulting, 6% engineering, 6% finance/banking, and 38% others. This diverse work environment helps businesses to engage with other industry professionals. Members of the coworking community can connect with like-minded people, foster collaboration opportunities, and may result in the formation of new innovative ideas altogether. 

Cost-Effective Workspaces: Cowrks provides flexible workspaces with membership plans, allowing businesses to choose the best fit for their organization according to their needs and budget. With Cowrks, companies only need to pay for their rented workspace. This eliminates the need to pay for overhead costs associated with parameters like maintenance, utilities, etc., of the office space.  

Access to First-Class Amenities: Cowrks offers various amenities, including high-speed internet, comfortable lounges, reception, support staff, meeting rooms, printing/copying facilities, a cafeteria, a professional business address, housekeeping, etc. Businesses may get additional discounts with workspaces if you are looking for a longer-term membership or availing multiple memberships at once. Respectfully negotiate the prices and ask for exclusive discounts. 

Promoting Innovation: Cowrks offers a collaborative and inspiring work environment to its clients. This empowers businesses to enhance their productivity levels and reach their full potential, leading the way to success. 

So, what are you waiting for? Grab instant office space solutions and be a part of the Cowrks community. 

Contact us at hello@cofynd.com if you have any queries or doubts.

seo.footer_description:
Awfis is a one-stop solution for modern coworking spaces and it offers technology-enabled premium seating arrangements such as hot desks, meeting rooms, virtual offices, dedicated desks, private cabins, enterprise solutions, Flexi desks, day passes, etc. This coworking space is highly suitable for all working professionals, freelancers, startups, small/large-scale businesses, and more. With access to Awfis membership, you can get connected with the world’s largest network of coworking spaces. It is spread across pan-India and provides daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly membership plans for all types of workspaces. 

Awfis is spread across many cities in India such as Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon, Bombay, Hyderabad, Chandigarh, Bhubaneswar, Kolkata,  Ahmedabad, Pune, Chennai, Indore, Bangalore, etc. Awfis has a total member base of 1500+ companies and it comprises 150 centers with 88,000 seats in total. Awfis Shared Office space gives you a chance to meet new professionals from diverse backgrounds to collaborate or build networks. Moreover, all the coworking spaces by Awfis are equipped with modern amenities such as a food lounge, high-speed elevators, a printer, ample parking space, CCTV surveillance, spacious & well-lit workstations, high-speed internet access, regular cleaning services, etc. 

Additionally, Awfis Space Solution Coworking Space provides meeting rooms on rent in luxurious hotels like Trident, Lemon Tree, Hyatt, Sarovar, Marine Plaza, etc. It also hosts various socializing activities, networking sessions, workshops, and fun experiences for its members. In the year 2016, Awfis was ranked under the 40 coolest coworking spaces in India published by Entrepreneur Magazine. All in all, Awfis stands for inspiration, excellence, maximum growth, minimum waste, priority to the community, integrity and most importantly getting more with less.

Top Awfis Coworking Spaces:-

Awfis offers a wide range of fully-furnished coworking spaces across various cities in India. Moreover, all of them are equipped with modern amenities for the comfort of their coworkers and other working professionals. Below is a list of the top Awfis coworking spaces

  1. 1. Awfis Nelson Mandela Marg

Awfis Nelson Mandela Marg is a reputable coworking space located in the heart of South Delhi, Vasant Kunj. This workplace is ideal for people from diverse backgrounds and offers affordable workplace solutions. A variety of workstations are offered by Awfis like dedicated desks, private cabins, hot desks, managed offices, day passes, conference rooms, and more. This workspace comprises 150 workstations, a terrace & 6 meeting rooms.  

Awfis coworking space is equipped with modern amenities such as high-speed elevators, CCTV surveillance, high-speed internet, power backup, a lounge, ample parking space, air-conditioning, washrooms, regular cleaning, and more. The nearest metro station to this coworking space is Munirka Metro Station at the magenta line i.e just 4.5km away. Moreover, some of the popular restaurants & luxury shopping malls close to this workspace are Setz, House Deli, Yum Yum Cha, The Chai Story, Friend’s Treat point, DLF Emporio, Ambience mall, etc. 

  1. 2. Awfis Camp Nucleus mall

Awfis Camp Nucleus mall is an exquisite coworking space located in Nucleus Mall, Pune. This coworking space is meticulously designed that offers fully functional & highly tech-enabled workstations such as hot desks, day pass, dedicated desks, private cabins, managed office space, etc. This entire Awfis coworking space is well-equipped with modern amenities & facilities such as high-speed elevators, power backup, free tea/coffee, reception, a pantry, ample parking space, cleaning services, well-lit and ventilated workstations, etc.

This Awfis shared office space is close to various bus terminals i.e GPO bus stop, Bright Petrol Pump Bus Stop & Westend Bus Stop located at a distance of less than 1km. Shivajinagar Railway Station is 4km away via Akluj Phule Nagar Road and Sangamwadi Road. The International Airport is 8.3 km away via the Airport Road. Moreover, this coworking space is close to various nearby landmarks within a radius of 3-5km such as Kumar Pacific mall, Gera mall, SGS mall, Oysters International School, Jehangir Hospital, Pune Medical Foundation, Effingut Brewerkz, 11 East Street Cafe and more. 

  1. 3. Awfis Ambience mall

This Awfis coworking space is located in Ambience mall which is the largest mall in India. It offers a variety of seating options such as dedicated desks, private cabins, managed office space, virtual office space, hot desks, day passes, etc. It provides access to modern amenities such as high-speed Wi-Fi, printers, scanners, tea/coffee dispenser, NFC-based cards, ample parking space, and more. 

All the members of the Awfis Ambience mall coworking space get access to Awfis Reward programs. It is close to Micromax Moulsari Avenue Metro Station & Indusland Bank Cyber City Metro Station, i.e. 1-2 km away from this location. The IGI Airport is 2-5km away from Awfis Ambience mall. Moreover, this location is surrounded by renowned eateries such as Spectra, Chili’s Ambience mall Gurgaon, Zanotta, Mamagoto, Auntie Fung’s Asian & Chinese, Diya, and more to chill out with your friends and colleagues. 

  1. 4. Awfis St. Marks Road

This Awfis coworking space is strategically located in the center of Bangalore and it boasts 800+ workspaces such as Flexi Desks, private cabins, hot desks, dedicated desks, day passes, conference rooms, and more. The entire workspace offers modern and high-tech enabled facilities such as high-speed elevators, WiFi, Power backup, 24/7 security, NFC-based access cards, CCTV monitoring, ergonomic furniture, well-lit & ventilated workstations, air-conditioning & centrally heated, etc.

It is well-connected with areas like Richmond town, M.G Road, Residency Road, Infantry road, Shivajinagar, and UB City. Some of the nearby cafes to hang out with your friends are Cafe Mor’ish, Kafegram food & Beverages, Cafe Treat, Istoria cafe, Mecca cafe many more. 

  1. 5. Awfis Connaught place 

This Awfis Space Solution coworking space is located in Connaught place, i.e. a hub of Millenials. This workplace belongs to all working professionals, freelancers, startups, and more at affordable rates to help them grow their businesses in a cost-effective manner. The Awfis shared office space has a vibrant atmosphere that creates efficiency and builds productivity. The entire workspace is filled with modern amenities such as high-speed internet, ensured security, CCTV monitoring, high-speed elevators, spacious & bright workstations, printer/scanner, projector, power backup, and ample parking space.

It offers an exciting range of seating options such as dedicated desks, hot desks, private cabins, managed office space, day passes, conference rooms, meeting rooms, and more. Moreover, this workspace is easily accessible via public transport as it is well-connected with the Rajiv Chowk metro station, i.e. 180 m away from the office. Shivaji Bridge railway station is located within a walking distance of this location. Commuting via cabs, autos, etc. is easy for coworkers to reach the office on time. It is close to the famous Palika Bazaar, Shankar market, Carnival Cinemas, Farzi cafe, Zaffran restaurant, Open House cafe, warehouse cafe, The Chai Story, Chaayos, Cafe Delhi Heights, Third Wave Coffee, and more.

Why choose Awfis Space Solution for Coworking Spaces?

Sophisticated locations with contemporary amenities: Awfis Coworking offers spaces in 10+ locations across India. These are Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Gurugram, Noida, Kolkata, Pune, Chandigarh, Ahmedabad, Chennai currently and upcoming in Udaipur, Dehradun, Indore, Aurangabad, Ghaziabad, Noida, and Jaipur. They offer amenities such as colorful workstations, high-speed internet, a pantry area, refreshments, ample parking space, and more. 

Maximum Productivity and Minimum Wastage: Awfis ensures the maximum amount of work productivity in its congenial environment at all times. With its modern amenities, members are bound to concentrate on their tasks, take a break and see their business growing at unmatched levels. This leads to minimum wastage of time, effort, and resources.
 
Socializing Events: Awfis Coworking ensures a fun-filled journey by organizing social events, workshops, networking sessions, parties, and much more. One is always encircled with a lot of zeal and enthusiasm for a better work lifestyle. 

Membership Benefits: Awfis has partnered with renowned brands that offer discounted and priority-based access to its coworking community.

Technology: Awfis offers the latest technology which helps in driving the maximum productivity out of its member community. 

So what’s keeping you in dilemma? Choose Awfis Space Solution Coworking Space today and thank them later!

With all the above benefits and more, one is bound to grow with Innov8’s coworking spaces. So, what’s keeping you in second thoughts? Hurry up and choose Innov8 coworking space today!

Premium locations: The Office Pass has coworking spaces in 3 top locations of Delhi NCR- South Delhi, Gurgaon and Noida.

Community activities: The Office Pass regularly organizes community events, workshops and sessions to let their members unwind from the hectic work schedule.

It offers coworking space solutions for modern businesses and benefits like power backup, private cabin, conference rooms, unlimited refreshments, breakout area, reception support, meeting rooms, managed reception, inspiring workstations, etc. 

These spaces come along with cost-effective membership plans including daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly plans. One can opt for these options according to their professional needs.

It provides additional perks to its members, including 24/7 office access on demand, instant professional business addresses, customizable private cabin solutions, complimentary chai and coffee, reception services, 24/7 customer support, and community for personal growth events. 

Their vision is to cater to a large base of professionals, be it a freelancer, a student, a digital nomad, a small startup, or even a remote team, it offers collaborative and affordable workspaces with opportunities for networking and professional development.

Moreover, it provides free access to meeting rooms and conference rooms for client and team meetings. This helps businesses to expand their network, form connections with other industrialists, and potentially lead to new innovative ideas through collaborative support.

No Hidden Costs: SupremeWork offices are aesthetically designed to cater to all your requirements, providing customizable plans to fit your organization’s budget. These spaces have a comprehensive variety of amenities at affordable monthly rent prices. Additionally, no hidden costs or long-term commitments are associated with the workspace solutions.

seo.footer_description:
91springboard is a vibrant coworking space which was started in January 2013. The motive of starting 91springboard coworking was to help the entrepreneurs of today and make their paths a bit easier and less lonely. 

91springboard has coworking spaces in 8 major cities of India - Gurgaon, Delhi, Noida, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Mumbai and Goa. It offers coworking spaces for a day in the form of day passes and monthly, yearly options in the form of hot desks, dedicated desks and private cabins.

91springboard Spaces boasts of best in class amenities like hassle free setup, no hidden costs, pay-p3er-use plans, 24x7 access, high-speed wifi, ample parking space, gaming and recreation zones, tech enabled meeting rooms, proximity to the metro station and most importantly all sanitization procedures have been kept in place in regard to the ongoing pandemic.

Over 2000 startups currently operate in 91springboard coworking spaces from different sectors like HR, E-Commerce, Accounting, Consulting, Real Estate, Pharmacy, Health Care and the count goes on. 

All in all, 91springboard stands for a strong sense of community networks, innovativeness, having flexibility to grow and taking all infrastructural management pains from its members.

Why choose 91springboard Coworking Spaces? 

Top-notch locations with abundant features: 91springboard coworking spaces gives you access to the high-end locations of India and plans to expand further soon.
 
Flexible coworking spaces: Flexibility is one of the crucial reasons why coworking spaces are a hit today. From working hours and an environment that suits a member, 91springboard offers 24x7 access with everything one needs to get work done. 

Mixture of clients: 91springboard has a mixed bag of clients ranging from healthcare, accounting, educating, fitness, education, legal, real estate, consulting, logistics, energy, entertainment, HR and many more. 

Community Engagement: 91springboard conducts over 2000 activities to destress their members from the hectic work lifestyle. From block chain workshops to fun filled open mic nights, there is something for everyone. These activities help the members to know each other better and foster a sense of belonging. 

Partnerships with Big corporate names: 91springboard coworking partners with the popular names like Paytm, Google, Facebook, Rentomojo, HubSpot, OYO Rooms, Exotel, Digital Ocean, Instamojo, AWS Activate, Uber etc. These provide massive deals that guarantee services worth Rs. 10,00,000 and more. 

Ample networking opportunities: Being one of the renowned coworking space providers, 91springboard spaces provides inexhaustive networking opportunities of various stakeholders, mentors, investors, partners and service providers, creating utmost value for everyone who wishes to be a part of its family. 

With above and more such benefits, one is surely bound to have a seamless professional journey. So, what’s keeping you in dilemma? Be quick and choose 91springboard coworking space today!

seo.footer_description:
SupremeWork India is a collaborative coworking space provider, located in Delhi, Gurugram, and Noida. It was founded by Girja Dutt Dabral in 2019. It offers coworking space solutions for modern businesses and benefits like power backup, private cabin, conference rooms, unlimited refreshments, breakout area, reception support, meeting rooms, managed reception, inspiring workstations, etc. 

These spaces come along with cost-effective membership plans including daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly plans. One can opt for these options according to their professional needs.

It provides additional perks to its members, including 24/7 office access on demand, instant professional business addresses, customizable private cabin solutions, complimentary chai and coffee, reception services, 24/7 customer support, and community for personal growth events. 

Their vision is to cater to a large base of professionals, be it a freelancer, a student, a digital nomad, a small startup, or even a remote team, it offers collaborative and affordable workspaces with opportunities for networking and professional development. 

Why Choose SupremeWork Coworking Spaces?

Increased Productivity: SupremeWork provides a diverse range of workspace solutions for modern businesses. Members can choose from open desks, dedicated desks, or customized private cabins, depending on their business needs and requirements. It fosters productivity and innovation by offering well-designed workspaces with comfortable furniture and professional work setup. 

Collaborative Environment: With SupremWork, members can connect with a like-minded community of professionals from various industries. Moreover, it provides free access to meeting rooms and conference rooms for client and team meetings. This helps businesses to expand their network, form connections with other industrialists, and potentially lead to new innovative ideas through collaborative support.

Facilities & Perks: SupremeWork Coworking spaces come fully equipped with amenities such as regular community events, complimentary beverages, ample parking space, metro connectivity, inspiring work stations, CCTV cameras, high-speed internet access, video conferencing facilities, printer/scanner facilities, game zone, and many more additional perks.  

No Hidden Costs: SupremeWork offices are aesthetically designed to cater to all your requirements, providing customizable plans to fit your organization’s budget. These spaces have a comprehensive variety of amenities at affordable monthly rent prices. Additionally, no hidden costs or long-term commitments are associated with the workspace solutions.  

So, what are you waiting for? Grab affordable workspaces and be a part of the SupremeWork community. 

Contact us at hello@cofynd.com if you have any queries or doubts.

seo.footer_description:
Spring House Coworking was founded in 2015 with a vision to create a seamless ecosystem and provide budding entrepreneurs with a platform to grow. 

It offers coworking spaces in 4 cities of India- Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida and Lucknow. The seating plan comprises private cabins, hot desks, dedicated desks, day access, meeting rooms, event spaces and virtual offices.

Spring House Coworking is fully equipped with best in class amenities - high-speed internet, in-house pantry, mail handling, printer, scanner, events space, housekeeping, 24 hrs power backup, no lock-in, proximity to the transport system, ample parking space and most importantly, all sanitization procedures have been kept in place keeping in mind the current pandemic.

Over 200 organizations are currently managing their business operations from Spring House’s coworking spaces. From Nokia, Nimbus, Adyogi, Clicks Bazaar, Insider, Jimmy’s Cocktails, Loan Tube to Borges, there is a range of big names in their member community. 

All in all, Spring House Coworking Spaces believes that the future of modern economics resides in collaborative and cooperative spaces- a future time that enjoys the shared economy concept and transforms the traditional working lifestyle. The brand aims to create an environment that encourages productivity, innovation and networking.

Why Choose Spring House Coworking Coworking Spaces? 

Premium locations: Spring House spaces are located in top-end cities of India with over 2800 operational seats from where 2500+ members work. 

Plethora of amenities: Spring House coworking spaces offer a host of premium amenities like resilient internet connection, in-house pantry, mail handling, printer & scanner, refreshments, events space, biometric-enabled, housekeeping, power backup, break-out zones, no lock-in, ample parking space and most importantly, all sanitization procedures have been kept in place keeping in mind the current pandemic.

Community Events: Spring House understands the importance of socialization and hence regularly organizes fun events, sessions, workshops and more for its members. This is to make them engaged and let them unwind from the work stress. 

Sanitization measures: Spring House has taken all necessary precautions keeping in view the current pandemic. Social distancing, use of masks, hand sanitiser, regular washing of hands, hygienic surroundings, temperature checks, visitor policy among others have been made mandatory in the interest of all community members. 

Diverse members: Spring House has an amazing community of people belonging to diverse backgrounds and fields. From IT, Health Care, Education, Legal, Accounting, Energy, HR, Food & Beverage to Real Estate, there’s everyone here.
 
Networking Opportunities:  Spring House ensures networking activities by giving opportunities to investors, mentors, stakeholders, partners, service providers and more. 

Flexibility: Whether you’re a professional individual or a startup, Spring House has a space for you. From private cabins, open seats, day access, meeting rooms, event spaces to virtual offices, there’s everything for everyone. 

With the above-mentioned benefits, one is sure to unwind while focusing on work completely. So, what are you waiting for? Hurry up and choose Spring House Coworking today!

seo.footer_description:
SupremeWork India is a collaborative coworking space provider, located in Delhi, Gurugram, and Noida. It was founded by Girja Dutt Dabral in 2019. It offers coworking space solutions for modern businesses and benefits like power backup, private cabin, conference rooms, unlimited refreshments, breakout area, reception support, meeting rooms, managed reception, inspiring workstations, etc. 

These spaces come along with cost-effective membership plans including daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly plans. One can opt for these options according to their professional needs.

It provides additional perks to its members, including 24/7 office access on demand, instant professional business addresses, customizable private cabin solutions, complimentary chai and coffee, reception services, 24/7 customer support, and community for personal growth events. 

Their vision is to cater to a large base of professionals, be it a freelancer, a student, a digital nomad, a small startup, or even a remote team, it offers collaborative and affordable workspaces with opportunities for networking and professional development. 

Why Choose SupremeWork Coworking Spaces?

Increased Productivity: SupremeWork provides a diverse range of workspace solutions for modern businesses. Members can choose from open desks, dedicated desks, or customized private cabins, depending on their business needs and requirements. It fosters productivity and innovation by offering well-designed workspaces with comfortable furniture and professional work setup. 

Collaborative Environment: With SupremWork, members can connect with a like-minded community of professionals from various industries. Moreover, it provides free access to meeting rooms and conference rooms for client and team meetings. This helps businesses to expand their network, form connections with other industrialists, and potentially lead to new innovative ideas through collaborative support.

Facilities & Perks: SupremeWork Coworking spaces come fully equipped with amenities such as regular community events, complimentary beverages, ample parking space, metro connectivity, inspiring work stations, CCTV cameras, high-speed internet access, video conferencing facilities, printer/scanner facilities, game zone, and many more additional perks.  

No Hidden Costs: SupremeWork offices are aesthetically designed to cater to all your requirements, providing customizable plans to fit your organization’s budget. These spaces have a comprehensive variety of amenities at affordable monthly rent prices. Additionally, no hidden costs or long-term commitments are associated with the workspace solutions.  

So, what are you waiting for? Grab affordable workspaces and be a part of the SupremeWork community.

Sanitization measures: Spring House has taken all necessary precautions keeping in view the current pandemic. Social distancing, use of masks, hand sanitiser, regular washing of hands, hygienic surroundings, temperature checks, visitor policy among others have been made mandatory in the interest of all community members. 

Diverse members: Spring House has an amazing community of people belonging to diverse backgrounds and fields. From IT, Health Care, Education, Legal, Accounting, Energy, HR, Food & Beverage to Real Estate, there’s everyone here.
 
Networking Opportunities:  Spring House ensures networking activities by giving opportunities to investors, mentors, stakeholders, partners, service providers and more. 

Flexibility: Whether you’re a professional individual or a startup, Spring House has a space for you. From private cabins, open seats, day access, meeting rooms, event spaces to virtual offices, there’s everything for everyone.

seo.footer_description:
Regus is a globally recognized workspace provider, founded by Mark Dixon in 1989. The first Regus office was in Brussels, now its centers are in more than 110 countries worldwide. After 2011, Regus is known as an IWG (International Workplace Group) company. 

Regus India is located in the main business hubs, including Delhi NCR, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Pune, Indore, Ahmedabad, etc. It offers private offices, day offices, custom offices, hot desks, dedicated desks, virtual offices, meeting rooms, and other benefits. These workspace solutions come along with modern amenities, including basic utilities, ergonomic furniture, high-speed Wifi, access to meeting/conference rooms, cleaning services, and breakout areas.

Businesses can opt for flexible rental terms and can scale up or down according to their needs and goals. Additionally, it has delivered its custom office and coworking space solutions to top-tier companies like Disney, Microsoft, Paypal, Samsung, Spotify, McAfee, Uber, Slack, Blackrock, Accenture, etc. 

Why Choose Regus Coworking Spaces?

Value for money: Regus workspaces eliminate the overhead costs, as now businesses can avoid high-cost parameters such as utilities, maintenance, and rent for the whole office. One only needs to pay the rent for the workspace that you are buying. Moreover, access to free amenities and facilities is provided to its clients. It caters to all types and sizes of companies, making it accessible according to one’s budget and needs. 

Business Opportunities: Regus conducts regular social events, sessions, and workshops to create networking opportunities. This helps businesses to interact with other industry professionals, often helping them to create their visibility in the targeted market. Additionally, these events can stimulate innovation within the dynamic Regus community. 

Accessibility: Regus offices are located in prime locations with easy access to public transportation. These include metro, buses, cabs, taxis, etc. This allows clients to travel hassle-free from one coworking space to another. Also, it enhances the brand’s visibility and creates networking opportunities with other professionals. 

Flexible Solutions: With Regus, one can choose from a wide range of flexible rental leases. Whether you need a workspace for a day, a week, or a year, Regus will provide all types of flexible time frame options. You can also use a workspace and opt for the pay-as-you-go rental contract. 

Modern Work Environment: Regus offices are aesthetically designed to improve one’s productivity and can help significantly improve an employee’s morale. These spaces come along with all the necessary amenities, allowing businesses to focus on their growth and future endeavors.  

So, what are you waiting for? Grab affordable workspaces and be a part of the Regus community.

seo.footer_description:
The Circle Work is a prestigious coworking space provider company, founded by Karanpal Singh in 2016. Their vision is to create a collaborative and vibrant community space for its partners and members. It provides carefully crafted workspace options that allow businesses to focus on their personal goals and growth. Workspaces include hot desks, dedicated desks, private cabins, day passes, event rooms, conference rooms, and board rooms.

Members can fully access state-of-the-art amenities, including ample parking space, metro connectivity, collaboration community, productive meeting spaces, super fast internet access, complimentary food and beverages, etc. Its centers are situated in strategic locations to facilitate accessibility to its clients and customers. Additionally, it focuses on client satisfaction and has earned the trust of notable clients like Blade, Good Times, Sova Health, SaveIn, Xane.ai, Xtracap Fintech, Oxyjon, Wellversed, True Balance, Raaho, and many more. 

Why Choose The Circle Work Coworking Spaces?

Improved Work-Life Balance: The Circle Work offers a professional and distraction-free work atmosphere that can help businesses to focus and enhance productivity, and overall work quality. It also conducts regular social events, workshops, and sessions for its members and clients. This helps businesses to form a connection with like-minded individuals often helping them to create their visibility in the targeted market.

Seamless Connectivity: The Circle Work boasts excellent connectivity to other parts of Delhi NCR through the Huda City Centre metro station, buses, cabs, taxis, auto-rickshaws, etc. This helps businesses reduce commute time and provides them convenience, helping them improve their work-life balance. 

Flexible Solutions: The Circle Work provides a wide spectrum of office space solutions to cater to all types of businesses and their specific needs. Workspaces include hot desks, dedicated desks, private cabins, day passes, event rooms, conference rooms, board rooms, etc., are offered with various amenities such as hassle-free setup, 24/7 work access, daily sanitization, fast internet, tea and coffee, housekeeping, etc. 

So, what are you waiting for? Grab affordable workspaces and be a part of the The Circle Work community.

name: Ananta Coworking
description:
Ananta Coworking, located in Welldone Tech Park on Sohna Road, Gurgaon, offers a premium workspace experience for professionals, startups, and enterprises alike. The centre enjoys a strategic location along the Sohna Elevated Corridor (NH-248A) — a six-lane access-controlled highway providing excellent connectivity to major business districts such as Cyber City and Udyog Vihar via NH-48.

The area is well-connected through key roads like Golf Course Extension Road, Southern Peripheral Road, and Netaji Subhash Marg, ensuring smooth accessibility from all parts of Gurgaon. Public transport is readily available through buses, cabs, and taxis, with Huda City Centre Metro Station (Yellow Line) just 20–25 minutes away. Moreover, IGI Airport and Gurgaon Railway Station are accessible within 30–40 minutes.

Sohna Road is a thriving commercial hub housing renowned business parks such as Vatika Business Park, IRIS Tech Park, Universal Trade Tower, and Unitech Infospace, making it a preferred destination for global corporations like Capgemini, Cognizant, McKinsey, and Aon.

Ananta Coworking offers modern workspaces, including private cabins, dedicated desks, meeting rooms, and hot desks, designed to foster collaboration, comfort, and productivity. Surrounded by upscale residential areas and retail spaces like Central Plaza and South Point Mall, it provides a perfect work-life balance for professionals.

Experience a dynamic workspace that blends accessibility, innovation, and comfort at Ananta Coworking – Welldone Tech Park, Sohna Road.

Settl. Coliving is a technology-driven accommodation platform aimed at offering affordable and high-quality experiences for the young population. 

Settl. Coliving spaces are located in the heart of Bangalore City. Some of their centres are in Koramangala, ITPL, HSR Layout and Doddanakundi with luxurious amenities like fully furnished rooms, 24x7 power and water backup, regular cleaning & maintenance, spacious balconies, trained housekeeping, high-speed internet connectivity, on-site laundry, all-inclusive rent with a nominal deposit, tech-enabled security, flexible terms, common spaces and most importantly, organisation of regular events for social interaction. 

Settl. promises to take away the daily hassle out of their members’ lives and help them save their valuable time for things that they love and are passionate about. 

Why choose Settl. for Coliving Spaces? 

Premium Locations: Settl. coliving spaces are spread across multiple locations in Bangalore- Koramangala, ITPL, HSR Layout and Doddanakundi. These areas are rapidly gaining importance as both student and corporate-friendly. 

Provision of amenities: All spaces are packed with world-class amenities like fully furnished rooms, 24x7 power and water backup, regular cleaning & maintenance, spacious balconies, trained housekeeping, high-speed internet connectivity, on-site laundry, all-inclusive rent with a nominal deposit, tech-enabled security, flexible terms, common spaces and most importantly, organisation of regular events for social interaction.

Economical spaces: Settl. spaces are economical in nature and give utmost attention to everyone’s specific needs and preferences. Furthermore, there is a well-organized announcement of discounts and offers for the community members at regular intervals of time. 

A mix of member communities: Settl. coliving residents are a mixture of multiple fields and backgrounds. From college students, working professionals and senior citizens from Bangalore and neighbouring areas, there’s a variety of individuals to interact with. 

High priority to cleanliness: Settl. is strictly ensuring the safety of its residents at the centre of doing operations and has introduced multiple measures like regular cleaning of all common touchpoints, touch-free food, e-commerce deliveries and disinfected rooms before move-in. 

With the above benefits and more, Settl. truly is one of the favourite living spaces of the millennial generation. So, what’s holding you back? Hurry up and choose Settl today!

name: B-URBAN COLIVING
description: B-urban Coliving – Designed for Working Women Professionals B-urban is a thoughtfully designed coliving space in Sector 23, Gurgaon, created exclusively for working women professionals. We understand the challenges women face in finding safe, comfortable, and community-driven accommodation, which is why B-urban offers a unique living concept that sets us apart from traditional PGs and hostels. At B-urban, all rooms are single occupancy, ensuring complete privacy and avoiding the overcrowded feel of shared rooms. Each private room is fully furnished with a mattress, study table and chair, modular wardrobe, mini fridge, and dressing mirror – giving you all the essentials for comfortable daily living. What makes B-urban truly unique is our focus on open zones and shared spaces. Every floor features spacious lounges and multiple common kitchens, fully equipped with microwaves, induction cooktops, toasters, cutlery, and cold-water dispensers. These areas are designed to encourage relaxation, productivity, and social connection, making B-urban more than just a place to stay. We provide 24/7 security, continuous water supply, inverter power backup, high-speed Wi-Fi, housekeeping services, car parking, and multiple fully automatic washing machines for your convenience. With these facilities included in your rent, you can enjoy a worry-free lifestyle. Strategically located on the Sector 23 service lane, B-urban offers easy accessibility while ensuring a safe and secure environment. By combining the privacy of personal space with the comfort of community living, B-urban is the ideal choice for women professionals seeking a balanced lifestyle in Gurgaon.
